name: Nucifer
summary: Nucifer demonstrated compact antineutrino monitoring beside the Osiris research reactor at Saclay. It was designed to test whether reactor power and fissile evolution could be followed with a robust detector suitable for safeguards research.
detection_principle: A compact gadolinium-loaded liquid-scintillator target identifies inverse beta decay. Delayed coincidences, shielding and cosmic-ray vetoes separate neutrinos from intense reactor-related gamma and neutron backgrounds.
